about: measure contests of 2022 in South Dakota, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2022 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/UYQIEP, version 5.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files sd22_cleaned.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

question.title: Constitutional Amendment D: An Initiated Amendment To The South Dakota Constitution Expanding Medicaid Eligibility.

threshold.rule: Majority of votes cast on the amendment
threshold.quote: Any constitutional amendment or revision must be submitted to the voters and shall become a part of the Constitution only when approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon.
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (amendment)

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (54 against 38.1 within 5 points, 2018 to 2024), so p may be low

question.title: Initiated Measure 27: An Initiated Measure Legalizing The Possession, Use, And Distribution Of Marijuana.

p.not_computed: the threshold of this state's statutes is not read

question.title: Supreme Court Justice Retention : Shall Justice Patricia J. Devaney Representing The Third Supreme Court District, Whose Term Expires January 1, 2023, Be Retained In Office?

p.not_computed: S.D. Const. art. V, §7; SDCL 16-1-2: threshold not stated in text read: the threshold turns on more than the yes share of those voting on the question, and the model forecasts that share only
